result.reason: The redline meets the fallback by covering affiliates without notice and permitting assignment in an M&A transaction, and it also covers contractors. It does not reach the preferred position: the annual non-renewal right and any Section 12 termination rights remain, so a subscription licence is not terminable only for uncured material breach; no perpetual, irrevocable treatment is provided for any paid-up licence. The margin comment therefore overstates the termination protection. In addition, the successor-assignment exception applies to both parties, unnecessarily allowing TrueLink to transfer the agreement without consent and potentially changing Client's counterparty. The new language is generally clear but should limit the assignment exception to Client and accurately address all licence termination routes.
